notes: Only for public school 9th graders in Boston, Cambridge and Somerville. Other nomination steps and dates are not on the page, so ask the academy. The page also mentions sophomore-year needs in its curriculum, which does not match the 9th grade rule.
name: Crimson Summer Academy
what_you_do: Three summers at Harvard for public school students. Summer one is on campus with classes and college planning. Summer two is six weeks of career exploration. Summer three is college-level courses at Harvard Summer School, for college credit.
who_can_apply: Public school students who are in 9th grade now in Boston, Cambridge or Somerville and are nominated by a principal, teacher or guidance counselor. Cohorts are 30 to 40 students.
pay_detail: Full tuition, room and board. $800 stipend the first summer, $200 per week in summers two and three. $3,000 college scholarship after finishing all three summers.
duration: 3 summers (summer one is on campus, summer two is 6 weeks, summer three is the 7-week Harvard Summer School)
deadline_text: The page does not list application dates.
how_to_apply: You must be nominated by a principal, teacher or counselor who knows you. Ask your school staff. Email crimsonsummer@harvard.edu for questions.
